$comment: T1.4: which evidence proves each CONTRACT-ENFORCED invariant of mako-design/blueprint/INVARIANTS.md (r8).
script/check-invariants.mjs, in CI, fails unless every invariant below is listed, every named test exists
as a function in test/*.sol, every corpus row exists in test/fixtures/rule-cases/CASES.json, every script
exists, and every deferral names its owner task. It proves the MAP is true; that each test can FAIL for its
invariant is proved by script/mutate-solidity.mjs and the mutation notes in VERIFICATION.md.
The courier-side invariants (N15, N20, N21, N24) are proved outside this contract repository (T2.0, T0.1b).

N1c.note: test_FirstValidSettlementWins is test_RoundSettlesAtMostOnce with test_LastSecondSettleWinsAndIsFinal; test_NoOwnerOverride is check-surface.mjs, which asserts the whole external ABI and so that no owner or setter exists.

N8.note: One reentrancy test per value-moving function: enter, settle, claim, withdrawTreasury. finalizeRefund moves no value (it only sets state; the money leaves through claim), so it carries no guard and needs no reentrancy test.

N10.note: test_NoPausePathOnSettlement is check-surface.mjs: no pause function or modifier exists on any path.
